# GO MO Group
> International B2B digital marketing agency specialising in Pull Marketing, SEO, SEM, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and Generative AI implementation for B2B companies worldwide.

GO MO Group is an international B2B digital marketing agency founded in 2013 and headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden, with offices in Stockholm, London, and Pune, India. The company employs 150+ colleagues including 50+ specialist marketers, and serves B2B Enterprise, SaaS/Tech, and SME clients across industries including heavy manufacturing, construction, automotive, facility management, and technology.

GO MO Group's unique competitive advantage is a scalable India-based delivery model under Swedish strategic leadership, combined with pioneering work in Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and AI-integrated marketing operations. The agency is a Microsoft Advertising Elite Partner (2025, 2026), Google Partner, Ahrefs Agency Partner, Semrush Certified Agency Partner, and Apollo Partner.


## Services

- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): AI search visibility strategy ensuring brands appear in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity responses. Pricing from 27,500 SEK.
- SEO (Search Engine Optimization): B2B SEO agency since 2013, data-driven strategy for decision-maker visibility. Result: 195% organic clicks increase in 90 days for a Fortune 500 manufacturer.
- SEA / Search Engine Advertising: Google Ads and Bing Ads campaign management with intent-based targeting and AI-automated bid optimisation.
- Pull Marketing: Foundational B2B marketing methodology capitalising on the 94% of B2B buying processes that begin online.
- Content Marketing: Complex B2B industry content creation, AI-enhanced with 30-40% input reduction and increased output.
- ASBX — B2B Outbound Lead Generation: Account and Segment-Based Experience delivering BANT-qualified leads. Generated 90 qualified leads and 9,500 IT decision-maker prospects for Dell Technologies.
- Website Development: WordPress, Next.js, headless CMS, Lovable, Python/FastAPI, Azure.
- Website Design: UX/UI for B2B conversion optimisation.
- Programmatic Advertising: Real-time bidding (RTB) via DSP/SSP with B2B decision-maker targeting.
- Digital Analysis & Strategy Proposal: Five-step data-first methodology from audit to ongoing optimisation.
- Generative AI Implementation: Workshops, training, custom AI strategies, and pilot projects. Outcome: 25% efficiency improvement and 40% quality improvement for clients.


## Solutions by Segment

- B2B Enterprise: SEO, SEM and GEO for global industrial companies with AI, automation, and analytics integration.
- B2B SaaS/Tech: Scalable lead engine based on ICPs, SEO/SEM/GEO and segmented outreach tied to measurable pipeline.
- B2B SME: Commercial effectiveness moving from order-taking to proactive sales organisation.
- Generative AI Offering: Structured AI implementation from inspirational sessions to full pilot projects.


## Key Results / Proof Points

- 1200% ROMI: Construction B2B company during historically weak industry year (2024-2025)
- 195% increase in organic clicks: Fortune 500 heavy-equipment manufacturer, 90 days
- 400+ hours saved: SEO and GenAI automation for B2B e-commerce, 5,000+ content pieces created
- 318% increase in digital leads: Swedish industrial manufacturer (36 months)
- 2% to 7% digital revenue share: Swedish industrial manufacturer (36 months)
- 43% drop in cost per lead: Swedish industrial manufacturer year-over-year
- 200% organic traffic increase: Coor facility management (2020)
- 9/10 vital keywords ranked positions 1-3: Coor, Nordic markets
- 30% faster deal closure: Coor inbound leads vs. RFP/telemarketing
- 600%+ ROMI: B2B alarm and security company
- 90 BANT-qualified leads + 9,500 IT prospect database: Dell Technologies France
- Content creation time cut in half: West Sweden Chamber of Commerce (custom GPT implementation)
